description: Object kinds a script can place (objects[].kind). Each kind lists its fields; at (position, metres), rotation (degrees), scale, hidden, parent (ride on another object: at becomes relative to it), part (with parent: ride on one of its named parts, e.g. a balance pan on the beam) and pivot ([x, y, z]: the point the object turns and grows about) apply to every kind.

fields.face: true for eyes, rosy cheeks and a smile on the front
fields.feeling: starting feeling for a face (face: true)

number_block.description: A rounded toy block with its number on the front and back faces.

letter.description: Extruded 3D text, centred on x and standing on its baseline (letters, digits, short words).

fields.clip: starting clip, default the character's idle
fields.feeling: starting feeling (Robo shows it with his face)

character.description: A rigged glTF character that plays catalog clips.

fields.area: [width, depth] of the drop zone, default [8, 4]

confetti.description: Seeded confetti that falls when a burst action fires it.

fields.color: colors.json name, overrides the body colour
fields.feeling: starting feeling: happy (default), sad, surprised, angry, worried, sleepy

critter.description: A toy animal that bobs, blinks and wags; targets <id>#head and named parts (tail) take rotation tweens; its eyes prop closes its eyes (sleep).

fields.color: colors.json name, overrides the main colour

prop.description: A toy object built from parts (catalog/models.json and catalog/models/*.json). Named parts (a lid, a door, a plank) are targets <id>#<part> for turn, move, wiggle and spin.

bubbles.description: Soap bubbles that float up and pop (with soft pop sounds) when a burst action fires them.

stars.description: A backdrop of slowly twinkling stars (no flashing) for night scenes.

fields.minuteHand: false starts with the long hand hidden

clock.description: A teaching clock that stands on its rim and faces the camera; the clock move turns its hands to a time (the hour hand moves with the minutes).

fields.aim: [x, y, z] the spot it points at (world)
fields.beam: true draws a faint cone of light

lamp.description: A spotlight that casts real shadows (shadow puppets, a torch in the dark). Place it with at; point it with aim; show and hide fade it.

weather.description: Rain, snow, falling leaves or petals that keep falling while the object is shown (show to start, hide to stop).

group.description: An empty holder: give other objects parent: <this id> and move, turn or grow them all as one (a rocket made of parts, a tray of cookies).
